summary: Lando Norris outpaced Ferrari's struggling machinery to secure McLaren's first victory of 2024, converting a strong qualifying position into a commanding drive at the Hungaroring. Ferrari's pre-race confidence evaporated as Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton limped home fourth and fifth respectively, prompting team principal acknowledgement they must improve execution in high-pressure situations. The win narrows the championship gap as McLaren accelerates toward the front of the constructors' battle while Ferrari grapples with unexpected performance deterioration.
